messages:
aisha.k: Quick follow-up from the infra-degradation postmortem — thanks everyone who helped. We need to lock ownership, Jira IDs, RACI, and clear ETAs for the action list. Reply with: I own <action> — <JIRA-ID> — <ETA>. Aim to have all tickets created by end of week.

ben_s: I own autoscaler tuning (root cause: aggressive scale-down). JIRA INF-4729 — ETA 2026-03-02. Will add benchmarks and a rollback plan.

carlos_g: I can take cache-eviction policy changes + test harness. JIRA INF-4730 — ETA 2026-03-05. Will coordinate data retention limits with storage team.

dana_ops: I'll own runbook updates and the oncall drill for this incident. JIRA INF-4731 — ETA 2026-03-01. Will set a 1hr tabletop next Tue and invite oncall rotation.

liz_pm: I'll be accountable for stakeholder comms and closure criteria. RACI sketch: A=liz_pm, R=ben_s/carlos_g/dana_ops, C=oncall, I=eng + cs. I propose a weekly 15m sync for 4 weeks to confirm progress.

incident-bot: Reminder: please create sub-tasks under INF-4729/30/31 and link postmortem tag "infra-degrade-2026-02-14".

ben_s: Added acceptance criteria to INF-4729. Quick note — there were 3 similar scale-down incidents last Q (2026-01-08, 2026-01-29, 2026-02-14). I'm going to open INF-4732 to track the recurring-pattern investigation — ETA 2026-03-09.

carlos_g: INF-4730 updated with test cases and perf thresholds. Flagging potential blocker: need temporary increased cache TTL from storage (cc @dana_ops).

dana_ops: ACK, I'll request quota and TTL change. If storage team needs a formal rollback window, propose 2026-03-04 02:00-04:00 UTC.

aisha.k: Good. Two operational asks: (1) add short acceptance criteria to each JIRA (what success looks like), (2) owners should add a single follow-up comment after completion that includes metrics and a link to validation scripts.

ben_s: Will add metrics: 95p latency and scale-up time targets.

carlos_g: Will include cache hit ratio target + regression test link.

liz_pm: For handoffs: dana_ops will run the first drill and then hand weekly follow-ups to rotating oncall. We should document rotation owner and a simple checklist in the playbook.

aisha.k: Agree. Also capturing action to evaluate whether our autoscaler thresholds should be part of the release checklist (INF-4733 — I will create it). ETA 2026-03-08.

incident-bot: Action checklist created: INF-4729, INF-4730, INF-4731, INF-4732, INF-4733.

ben_s: One more ask — can we set a monthly recurring alert that surfaces similar scale-down patterns to the Reliability dash? If infra-team OK, I'll prototype.

dana_ops: Sounds good. I'll add it to the drill agenda.

liz_pm: Thanks all. Please update JIRA by Friday COB and set the ETA fields. I'll follow up with calendar invites for the weekly 15m syncs. :thumbsup:

aisha.k: Thanks — closing this thread for assignments. If anything changes, post here with the JIRA ID.
